payloads.oldHeading: Deduction in respect of life insurance premia, deferred annuity, contributions to provident fund, subscription to certain equity shares or debentures, etc.
payloads.newHeading: Deduction in respect of investments and specified payments
payloads.newText:
Section 123. Deduction in respect of investments and specified payments.—
(1) In computing the total income of an assessee, being an individual or a Hindu undivided family, there shall be deducted, in accordance with and subject to the provisions of this section, an amount equal to the aggregate of the sums paid or deposited in the tax year by the assessee towards any of the eligible investments, contributions, deposits, or expenditures specified in Schedule XV.

(2) The aggregate amount of deduction under sub-section (1) shall not exceed one hundred and fifty thousand rupees in any tax year.

(3) Where any sum is paid or deposited towards an eligible life insurance policy or contract as specified in Schedule XV, the deduction under sub-section (1) shall be admissible only to the extent such payment does not exceed ten per cent of the actual capital sum assured:
Provided that where the policy was issued on or after the 1st day of April, 2012, but on or before the 31st day of March, 2013, the limit shall be twenty per cent.

(4) If any eligible investment or asset specified in Schedule XV is transferred, terminated, surrendered, or encashed within the minimum holding period prescribed in the said Schedule, the aggregate amount of deduction allowed under sub-section (1) in respect of such investment in any earlier tax year shall be deemed to be the income of the assessee of the tax year in which such transfer, termination, surrender, or encashment occurs.

Section 123. Deduction in respect of investments and specified payments.—
(1) In computing the total income of an assessee, being an individual or a Hindu undivided family, there shall be deducted, in accordance with and subject to the provisions of this section, an amount equal to the aggregate of the sums paid or deposited in the tax year by the assessee towards any of the eligible investments, contributions, deposits, or expenditures specified in Schedule XV.

(4) If any eligible investment or asset specified in Schedule XV is transferred, terminated, surrendered, or encashed within the minimum holding period prescribed in the said Schedule, the aggregate amount of deduction allowed under sub-section (1) in respect of such investment in any earlier tax year shall be deemed to be the income of the assessee of the tax year in which such transfer, termination, surrender, or encashment occurs.

correspondingProvisions.title: ELIGIBLE INVESTMENTS, CONTRIBUTIONS, DEPOSITS, AND SPECIFIED EXPENDITURES FOR DEDUCTION UNDER SECTION 123
correspondingProvisions.relationship: Itemized catalogue of eligible instruments (Life Insurance, PF, PPF, Sukanya Samriddhi, NHB, ELSS, Tuition fees, Housing principal)
correspondingProvisions.text:
SCHEDULE XV
[See section 123]
ELIGIBLE INVESTMENTS, CONTRIBUTIONS, DEPOSITS, AND SPECIFIED EXPENDITURES FOR DEDUCTION UNDER SECTION 123

Part A: Insurance and Annuity Plans
1. Premium paid to effect or keep in force an insurance on the life of the individual, spouse, or any child of the individual, or any member of the Hindu undivided family.
2. Premium paid to effect or keep in force a contract for a deferred annuity on the life of the individual, spouse, or any child of the individual.
3. Contribution to an approved annuity plan of the Life Insurance Corporation of India or any other registered insurer.

Part B: Provident Funds and Pension Schemes
4. Contribution to any provident fund to which the Provident Funds Act, 1925 applies, or to any recognized provident fund.
5. Contribution to an approved superannuation fund.
6. Contribution to the Public Provident Fund scheme established under the Government Savings Promotion Act, 1873.
7. Contribution by an employee of the Central Government to the Tier-II specified account of the pension scheme referred to in section 124.

Part C: Government Savings, Time Deposits, and Specified Securities
8. Subscription to National Savings Certificates (VIII Issue / IX Issue).
9. Deposit under the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme Rules, 2019.
10. Term deposit for a period not less than five years with a scheduled bank in accordance with a scheme framed by the Central Government.
11. Five-year time deposit in an account under the Post Office Time Deposit Rules, 2019.
12. Subscription to notified bonds issued by the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD).

Part D: Mutual Funds, Equities, and Housing Finance
13. Subscription to units of Equity Linked Saving Scheme (ELSS) of any Mutual Fund registered with SEBI.
14. Subscription to eligible issue of equity shares or debentures approved by the Central Board of Direct Taxes.
15. Deposit scheme of, or pension fund set up by, the National Housing Bank (NHB).
16. Payment towards tuition fees (excluding coaching, donation, or capitation fees) for full-time education of any two children at any university, college, school, or educational institution situated within India.
17. Installment or part-payment towards the cost of purchase or construction of a residential house property, repayment of loan borrowed from Government, bank, LIC, NHB, or employer.

payloads.oldHeading: Certain deductions to be only on actual payment
payloads.oldText:
Section 43B. Certain deductions to be only on actual payment.—
Notwithstanding anything contained in any other provision of this Act, a deduction otherwise allowable under this Act in respect of—
(a) any sum payable by the assessee by way of tax, duty, cess or fee, by whatever name called, under any law for the time being in force, or
(b) any sum payable by the assessee as an employer by way of contribution to any provident fund or superannuation fund or gratuity fund or any other fund for the welfare of employees, or
(c) any sum referred to in clause (ii) of sub-section (1) of section 36, or
(d) any sum payable by the assessee as interest on any loan or borrowing from any public financial institution or a State financial corporation or a State industrial investment corporation, in accordance with the terms and conditions of the agreement governing such loan or borrowing, or
(da) any sum payable by the assessee as interest on any loan or advance from a non-banking financial company, or
(e) any sum payable by the assessee as interest on any loan or advances from a scheduled bank or a co-operative bank, or
(f) any sum payable by the assessee as an employer in lieu of any leave at the credit of his employee, or
(g) any sum payable by the assessee to the Indian Railways for the use of railway assets, or
(h) any sum payable by the assessee to a micro or small enterprise beyond the time limit specified in section 15 of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (27 of 2006),
shall be allowed (irrespective of the previous year in which the liability to pay such sum was incurred by the assessee according to the method of accounting regularly employed by him) only in computing the income referred to in section 28 of that previous year in which such sum is actually paid by him:
Provided that nothing contained in this section [except clause (h)] shall apply in relation to any sum which is actually paid by the assessee on or before the due date applicable in his case for furnishing the return of income under sub-section (1) of section 139 in respect of the previous year in which the liability to pay such sum was incurred.
payloads.newHeading: Deductions allowable only upon actual payment
payloads.newText:
Section 37. Deductions allowable only upon actual payment.—
(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, a deduction in respect of any statutory tax, duty, cess, employer contribution to employee welfare funds, interest on institutional borrowings, leave encashment, or payments due to micro and small enterprises under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006, shall be allowed only in the tax year in which such sum is actually discharged by payment.

(2) Provided that sums paid on or before the due date for furnishing the return of income under section 263 shall be allowed in the tax year in which the liability was incurred, except in respect of sums payable to micro or small enterprises which must be paid within the time limit prescribed under section 15 of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006.

payloads.oldHeading: Expenditure incurred in relation to income not includible in total income
payloads.oldText:
Section 14A. Expenditure incurred in relation to income not includible in total income.—
(1) For the purposes of computing the total income under this Chapter, no deduction shall be allowed in respect of expenditure incurred by the assessee in relation to income which does not form part of the total income under this Act.

(2) The Assessing Officer shall determine the amount of expenditure incurred in relation to such income which does not form part of the total income under this Act in accordance with such method as may be prescribed, if the Assessing Officer, having regard to the accounts of the assessee, is not satisfied with the correctness of the claim of the assessee in respect of such expenditure in relation to income which does not form part of the total income under this Act.

(3) The provisions of sub-section (2) shall also apply in relation to a case where an assessee claims that no expenditure has been incurred by him in relation to income which does not form part of the total income under this Act.

Explanation.—For the removal of doubts, it is hereby clarified that notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Act, the provisions of this section shall apply and shall be deemed to have always applied in a case where the income, not forming part of the total income under this Act, has not accrued or arisen or has not been received during the previous year relevant to an assessment year and the expenditure has been incurred during the said previous year in relation to such income not forming part of the total income.
payloads.newHeading: Disallowance of expenditure incurred in relation to exempt income
payloads.newText:
Section 14. Disallowance of expenditure incurred in relation to exempt income.—
(1) No deduction shall be allowed in computing total income under this Act in respect of any expenditure incurred by the assessee in relation to income which does not form part of the total income under this Act.

(2) The Assessing Officer shall compute the disallowance in accordance with the prescribed statutory formula if not satisfied with the correctness of the accounts or claim of the assessee, or where the assessee claims that no expenditure was incurred in earning exempt income.

Explanation.—This section applies irrespective of whether exempt income has actually accrued, arisen, or been received during the relevant tax year.

payloads.oldText:
Section 37. General.—
(1) Any expenditure (not being expenditure of the nature described in sections 30 to 36 and not being in the nature of capital expenditure or personal expenses of the assessee), laid out or expended wholly and exclusively for the purposes of the business or profession shall be allowed in computing the income chargeable under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession".

Explanation 1.—For the removal of doubts, it is hereby declared that any expenditure incurred by an assessee for any purpose which is an offence or which is prohibited by law shall not be deemed to have been incurred for the purpose of a business or profession and no deduction or allowance shall be made in respect of such expenditure.

Explanation 2.—For the removal of doubts, it is hereby declared that for the purposes of sub-section (1), any expenditure incurred by an assessee on the activities relating to corporate social responsibility referred to in section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013 shall not be deemed to be an expenditure incurred by the assessee for the purposes of the business or profession.

Explanation 3.—For the removal of doubts, it is hereby clarified that the expression "expenditure incurred by an assessee for any purpose which is an offence or which is prohibited by law" shall include and shall be deemed to have always included any expenditure incurred by an assessee for any purpose which is an offence under, or which is prohibited by, any law for the time being in force, in India or outside India.

correspondingProvisions.title: INCOMES EXEMPT FROM TAX
correspondingProvisions.relationship: Comprehensive consolidation of all statutory exemptions and exclusions from total income
correspondingProvisions.text:
SCHEDULE III
[See section 11]
INCOMES EXEMPT FROM TAX UNDER THE INCOME-TAX ACT, 2025

Part A: Agricultural and Family Incomes
1. Agricultural income derived from land situated in India.
2. Sums received by a member out of the income or estate of a Hindu undivided family.
3. Share of a partner in the total income of a partnership firm or LLP assessed as such.

Part B: Retiral and Terminal Benefits
4. Death-cum-retirement gratuity received by government and non-government employees within prescribed statutory ceilings.
5. Cash equivalent of leave salary paid upon retirement or superannuation.
6. Commuted pension received from government or approved pension fund.

Part C: Capital and Insurance Receipts
7. Proceeds of life insurance policy compliant with premium-to-sum-assured ratios specified in Schedule XV.
8. Receipts from recognized provident fund, public provident fund, and approved superannuation fund.

Part D: Institutional and Public Entities
9. Incomes of registered mutual funds, venture capital funds, and alternative investment funds.
10. Income of approved educational institutions, universities, hospitals, and medical research foundations.

payloads.oldHeading: Special provision in respect of newly established undertakings in free trade zones, etc.
payloads.oldText:
Section 10A. Special provision in respect of newly established undertakings in free trade zones, etc.—
(1) Subject to the provisions of this section, any profits and gains derived by an assessee from an undertaking to which this section applies shall not be included in the total income of the assessee:
Provided that no deduction under this section shall be allowed to an assessee who does not furnish a return of income on or before the due date specified under sub-section (1) of section 139.

(2) This section applies to any undertaking which manufactures or produces articles or things or computer software in any free trade zone, electronic hardware technology park, or software technology park.

(3) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1), no deduction shall be allowed to any undertaking for assessment year beginning on the 1st day of April, 2012 and subsequent years.

payloads.oldText:
Section 2. Definitions.—
In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires,—
(1A) "agricultural income" means—
(a) any rent or revenue derived from land which is situated in India and is used for agricultural purposes;
(b) any income derived from such land by agriculture, or the performance of any process ordinarily employed by a cultivator;
(c) any income derived from any building required as a dwelling house or out-house on such land.

(7) "assessee" means a person by whom any tax or any other sum of money is payable under this Act, and includes every person in respect of whom any proceeding under this Act has been taken.

(9) "assessment year" means the period of twelve months commencing on the 1st day of April every year.

(14) "capital asset" means property of any kind held by an assessee, whether or not connected with his business or profession, but does not include stock-in-trade, personal effects, or agricultural land.

(24) "income" includes—
(i) profits and gains;
(ii) dividend;
(iia) voluntary contributions received by a trust;
(iii) the value of any perquisite or profit in lieu of salary;
(iv) any special allowance or benefit granted to meet expenses.

(31) "person" includes—
(i) an individual,
(ii) a Hindu undivided family,
(iii) a company,
(iv) a firm,
(v) an association of persons or a body of individuals,
(vi) a local authority, and
(vii) every artificial juridical person.
